scope: Frozen published lunar date labels for stored Hong Kong weather-study issue dates, not astronomy or a complete calendar
year_label_convention: lunar_new_year: numeric lunar-year label follows Gregorian year containing the printed non-leap first lunar month start; preceding dates retain prior numeric year
date_policy: Hong Kong civil date; no time-of-day, instant, solar-term month or seasonal authentication
leap_flag_provenance: Repeated English numbered month is cross-checked against the explicit printed Chinese 閏 marker at the same month start
